inputs.text: Wake up. They are trying to sell you this fairy tale about a natural "political transition" and a regime that is "tottering," but it is all a smokescreen for a completely orchestrated takeover by the hidden elites. Look at the real script they are pushing—they claim residents own nothing and are "too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island." That is not an accident; it is the exact design. They engineered this entire manufactured crisis so that "a large and wealthy diaspora community (and potentially also foreign investors)" could follow their predetermined plan to "swoop in and buy property and businesses at bargain prices." It is a calculated trap by the syndicates behind the curtain to strip everyone bare and hand over the assets while everyone is looking the other way.
